namedValues.name: entra-tenant-id
namedValues.purpose: Microsoft Entra tenant whose v2 tokens are accepted.

namedValues.name: entra-audience
namedValues.purpose: Microsoft Foundry token audience used by Claude Code.

namedValues.name: allowed-principal-ids
namedValues.purpose: Semicolon-delimited allowlist of Microsoft Entra user or service-principal object IDs.

namedValues.name: rate-limit-calls
namedValues.purpose: Maximum requests per principal in each renewal window.

namedValues.name: rate-limit-renewal-seconds
namedValues.purpose: Per-principal rate-limit renewal window in seconds.

namedValues.name: approved-model-deployment-routes
namedValues.purpose: Semicolon-delimited model=deployment allowlist containing no tenant identifiers.

namedValues.name: foundry-backend-id
namedValues.purpose: APIM backend entity configured for the approved Foundry endpoint.

namedValues.name: foundry-managed-identity-resource
namedValues.purpose: Managed identity token audience for Foundry inference.

prerequisites: Identify every Microsoft Entra principal authorized to invoke the gateway.
Deploy the APIM service with its system-assigned managed identity.
Grant the APIM identity Cognitive Services User on the Foundry account.
Create the Foundry backend, API, POST wildcard operation, and non-secret named values.
Review approved model-to-deployment routes before typing ACCEPT.

securityProperties.callerAuthentication: Microsoft Entra JWT with explicit principal allowlist
securityProperties.rateLimitKey: validated oid claim with sub fallback
